plot: On the night of the Lantern Parade the Lantern Star goes dark; Bolt tests Grumpy (hides a shiny Best Grump trophy), Pip and Bertha, then zig-zag skid marks reveal Turbo took the star because he is secretly scared of the dark; everyone shares their fear and drives the parade together, then a golden key falls from the sky.

script.title: The Lights Went OUT in Wheelburg! 🌙😱 Cartoon Cars Mystery
script.description: On the night of the Lantern Parade the big star goes dark. Inspector Bolt follows zig-zag skid marks.

beats.say: Vroom! Zoom! It was the night of the Lantern Parade, and every car in Wheelburg rushed to the square!
Look! The Lantern Star! It's so bright, I'm not scared of the night at all!
Tonight we drive all around town with our lights on. Beep beep, everybody!
I'll lead the parade, of course. Fastest lights in Wheelburg!
Lights. Lanterns. Sparkles. Everything is shiny tonight. Wonderful.
Then a little wind whistled across the square, and the lantern flickered...
Ahh! It's so dark! I can't see my own wheels!
Nobody panic! I'm panicking! But nobody else panic!
Who switched off the star? Now there's no parade!
Finally. Some peace and quiet.
Then two calm headlights came slowly around the corner.
Good evening. Inspector Bolt. Someone has switched off the Lantern Star, and I intend to find out who.
Inspector, please hurry. The dark is really, really big.
Everyone will visit the Truth Press tonight. One car at a time.
Sorry, I can't. I have a very important race. With the moon.
The moon can wait. Grumpy, you go first tonight.
Me first? Fine. I didn't even want a parade.
Grumpy, did you switch off the Lantern Star?
No. And there is nothing shiny in my truck. Nothing at all.
The press pushed down, and out rolled something gold!
Grumpy! You always say you hate shiny things!
It says Best Grump in Wheelburg. I won it three years in a row. I polish it every night.
Aww! Grumpy has a secret happy thing!
Tell anyone, and I will be even grumpier.
A trophy cannot switch off a star, and your eyes are back to normal. Next, little Pip.
Me? But I'm the one who's scared of the dark!
Why would I turn off the only light in town?
The press came down slowly. Very, very slowly.
Hee! That feels like a great big hug!
Tiny eyes, tiny car, true words. You're free, Pip.
Big Bertha, your turn.
Oh dear, oh dear! I'm so big, that press will never fit me!
But I'm brave! Squeeze away! I have nothing to hide!
Squish! The Truth Press came down on the big yellow bus.
Your eyes stayed small, Bertha. Honest as always.
Honest and flat! Every single time! Why is it always my roof?!
Procedure. Thank you, Bertha.
Three cars. Three true answers. But the square was still dark.
Inspector Bolt switched on his brightest headlights and looked down at the ground.
Skid marks. Long, wiggly skid marks, right next to the lantern.
And only one car in Wheelburg brakes in a zig-zag.
One by one, every headlight turned to the same red car.
What? Me? Ha ha. Lots of cars zig-zag. Probably.
Nobody zig-zags. Except you.
Turbo. It's your turn at the Truth Press.
Okay, okay! I don't need the press. I'll tell you everything.
Turbo opened his trunk, and there was the Lantern Star, glowing inside!
Turbo! Why would you take the parade light?
Because... I'm scared of the dark. Really, really scared.
My garage is so dark at night. I wanted to keep the star right next to my bed.
I'm the fastest car in town. Fast cars aren't supposed to be scared.
Please don't tell anyone. Oh wait. Everyone is here.
Nobody laughed. Inspector Bolt rolled gently over to Turbo.
Turbo. Everybody is scared of something. Even detectives.
It's okay to be scared. Say it out loud, and your friends will come closer.
But taking the light made everybody else scared too. That part was not okay.
You're right. I'm sorry, everybody. I only thought about me.
I'm scared too! Let's be scared together. Then it's only half as scary!
And I'll park right next to your garage tonight! My headlights are huge!
You can borrow my trophy. It's shiny. Good night-light.
Grumpy! You really are the best grump ever!
I know. It says so on my trophy.
Turbo carried the Lantern Star back to the podium, very carefully.
Case closed. Now, I believe somebody promised us a parade.
And the cars drove around Wheelburg side by side, with every light shining.
Look, Pip! When we drive together, the dark isn't scary at all!
But just as the parade ended, something fell out of the sky. Clink!
A golden key? Who dropped it? Where did it come from?
Hmm. A key always opens something. Procedure.
Where could this little key lead? Inspector Bolt will find out next time!

long.title: The Lights Went OUT in Wheelburg! 🌙😱 Cartoon Cars Mystery
long.description:
On the night of the Lantern Parade, the big star in Wheelburg suddenly goes dark and little Pip is scared! Inspector Bolt sends Grumpy, Pip and Big Bertha to the Truth Press, finds a shiny secret and follows zig-zag skid marks to a big surprise. It's okay to be scared — say it out loud, and your friends will come closer. Inspector Bolt #3

En la noche del Desfile de Linternas, la gran estrella de Wheelburg se apaga y la pequeña Pip tiene miedo. El Inspector Bolt lleva a todos a la Prensa de la Verdad y sigue unas huellas en zigzag hasta una gran sorpresa. Está bien tener miedo: dilo en voz alta y tus amigos se acercarán. Inspector Bolt #3

fr.title: Les lumières se sont ÉTEINTES à Wheelburg ! 🌙😱 Voitures
fr.description:
La nuit du Défilé des Lanternes, la grande étoile de Wheelburg s'éteint et la petite Pip a peur. L'inspecteur Bolt envoie tout le monde à la Presse de Vérité et suit des traces en zigzag jusqu'à une grosse surprise. Ce n'est pas grave d'avoir peur : dis-le, et tes amis viendront plus près. 랜턴 퍼레이드 밤, 휠버그의 큰 별이 꺼지고 작은 핍은 무서워해요. 볼트 경감은 모두를 진실 프레스에 세우고 지그재그 바퀴 자국을 따라가 깜짝 놀랄 범인을 찾아요. 무서워도 괜찮아요. 소리 내어 말하면 친구들이 가까이 와 줄 거예요. 볼트 경감 #3

#어린이만화 #자동차 #잠자리동화

de.title: In Wheelburg ging das Licht AUS! 🌙😱 Auto-Krimi für Kinder
de.description:

Inspektor Bolt #3
